Economy · India

Indian stock markets decline amid global and domestic concerns

Indian stock markets experienced a decline in early trade, with the Sensex and Nifty indices falling. This downturn is attributed to a combination of factors including geopolitical tensions in West Asia, specifically US-Iran negotiations, and concerns related to the monsoon's impact. Some reports also noted FII outflows and global tech weaknesses affecting specific sectors like IT.
